instruction: A candid full-shot documentary photograph of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right, extending his left arm to touch the right shoulder of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands on the right, facing left, looking towards him. No bystanders are present. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
